prerequisite: Provision a disposable alice account; sign in; retain its secure cookie and session-bound CSRF token.
required_invariant: Reject the invalid supported Id value as a typed validation error (HTTP 400) without inserting a record; matching request.form's Err must render the application's validation page; a subsequent healthy request must work.

baseline.classification: Supported Id field's invalid value falls through to unsupported-type error, bypassing normal Result/Err validation feedback. No write occurred.
